verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents an agent that takes natural-language tasks and works on code autonomously, including opening pull requests with proposed changes. That is the core of a non-engineer driving an implementation. Nothing in the evidence shows it accepting a mockup or design file as input, or producing a working UI from one. missing for 10: documented mockup/design/image-to-code input, evidence of building a full feature or UI from a design, a non-engineer workflow that skips review or handoff, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can go from a mockup or design to a working implementation without an engineering handoff

citations.quote: Type natural language tasks and receive instant feedback
open a pull request with a proposed fix
the user sets an objective, the agent keeps working toward it
Web-based GUI, Terminal UI, and CLI
